ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food chain diagram, what happens to the number of wolves when the number of sheep increases?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food chain schematic diagram; Grass on the left has an arrow pointing to Sheep; Sheep also has an arrow pointing to Wolf, indicating that sheep are one of the food sources for wolves. Reasoning: The question asks what will happen to the number of wolves when the number of sheep increases. Because the figure shows sheep pointing to wolf, it means wolves eat sheep; if there are more sheep, wolves have more food available, so the number of wolves will also increase.
